devdoc.details: Replacing this verifier rotates the EIP-712 domain and invalidates signed but unsubmitted scans.

EIP712DomainChanged().details: MAY be emitted to signal that the domain could have changed.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

verifyNonPayment((bytes32,bytes32,bytes[.details: View-only and stateless; the caller binds the returned details to its own release record.

renounceOwnership().notice: Ownership renunciation is disabled so the signature dependency stays managed.

setAttestationVerifier(address).notice: GOVERNANCE ONLY: Replaces the verifier used for witness-signature checks.

userdoc.notice: Stateless EIP-712 verifier for seller-history scans, laid out like DisputeVerifier: the arbitrator calls this verifier, which calls the attestation verifier for the witness-signature check.
